local SPELL = {name = "exevo mas morir", mana = 12000} 
local ITEM = {id = 7368, amount = 100, cap = 50}
local playercap = freecap()


macro(100, "Conjure Assassin", function()
  if not g_game.isOnline() then
    return
  end

    local amount = itemAmount(ITEM.id) 
    if ITEM.cap < playercap then
        if mana() >= SPELL.mana then
          if amount < ITEM.amount then
              say(SPELL.name)  
          end
        end
    end

  delay(math.random(500, 800))
end)

--Revive pet
local useHerb = true
local petBodies = {6068,5526} -- 

macro(500,"Revive pet", function()
    for i, tile in ipairs(g_map.getTiles(posz())) do
        for u,item in ipairs(tile:getItems()) do
            if useHerb and table.find(petBodies, item:getId()) and findItem(34234) then
                useWith(34234, item)
            end
        end
    end
end)
